milestone: independent conjunct-level mutants of the frozen r83 counter beyond the frozen 50
method: Each mutant replaces one unique source substring of the frozen counter with a weaker rule. The frozen battery (negatives-showpicker-r83.mjs) is copied beside the mutant counter in /fast/scratch/hyaku/tabi-r83/R83Mut1/mut-<id>/ and run with --lane <frozen lane> --real <scored receipt> --expect-driver-sha256 <receipt driver pin> --expect-nonce <receipt nonce> --expect-fixture-sha256 <receipt fixture pin> --prior-set <frozen prior set> --work <mutant work> --json. Lane files were never edited; the pre/post hashes below are identical. Survivors were then witnesses: a receipt mutated in the weakened dimension is run through the pristine counter and the mutant counter; pristine finding + mutant clean = behavioral escape, pristine finding + mutant finding = redundant conjunct (a sibling check still rejects the receipt).

invocation.note: the receipt nonce on disk is the scored run nonce; the lane selftest derives all three expected values from the same receipt, and the frozen baseline is green under them. The assignment header nonce (tabi-r83-l1-9d90392aca79) is not the receipt nonce and would make the pristine baseline fail nonce-expected, which is inconclusive rather than a kill; claims.json also carries a third (older) nonce.

vacuousExcluded.name: leg-marks-min-count-relaxed
vacuousExcluded.why: marks[0]=="start", marks[1]=="pre" and marks[last]=="settle" already force at least three positions: a 2-element array would need one element to be both pre and settle, and a 1-element array fails index 1. The >=3 conjunct is redundant, so no valid receipt distinguishes >=3 from >=2. Excluded as vacuous, not counted as a survivor.

vacuousExcluded.why: d=undefined requires r.fixtureInputs to lack a PLAN target id; fixture-descriptors compares r.fixtureInputs to FIXTURE_INPUTS exactly and plan-frozen pins the leg target, so no receipt can reach mode-law with a missing descriptor. Excluded as redundant/vacuous.

vacuousExcluded.name: replay-tolerance-tightened
vacuousExcluded.why: TOL only affects (ts,at) pair matching, and event-time-quantum forces all accepted times onto a 0.1 ms grid; an on-grid pair is either exactly equal or at least 0.1 ms apart, so TOL=0.005 and TOL=0.05 accept/refuse the same receipts. Witnessed: a 31-match boundary receipt is still refused by both. Excluded as a dead threshold knob.
